messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Polish, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Polish line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
100 Wiele jest zwierząt, z którymi ona się żeni, 101 i będzie ich jeszcze więcej aż do przyjścia psa 102 przyjdzie, który sprawi, że ona umrze z żalu.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Step 2 → Polish)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Polish) | Back‑Translation (Polish → English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|--------------------------------------|--------| | Molti | quantifier “many” | **Wiele** | many | OK | | son | copular verb “are” | **jest** | is/are | OK | | li | definite article (plural) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | animali | noun “animals” | **zwierząt** | animals (genitive) | OK | | a | preposition “with” | **z** | with | OK | | cui | relative pronoun (object of *a*) | **którymi** | which (instrumental) | OK | | s'ammoglia | reflexive verb “she wives” | **się żeni** | she marries | OK | | e | coordinating conjunction “and” | **i** | and | OK | | più | comparative adverb “more” | **więcej** | more | OK | | saranno | future copula “shall be” | **będzie** | will be | OK | | ancora | adverb “still / yet” | **jeszcze** | still / yet | OK | | infin | subordinating conjunction “until” | **aż** (as part of **aż do**) | until | OK | | che | relative/conjunctive “that” (introducing clause) | **że** | that (subordinator) | OK | | ’l | definite article “the” (elided) | — | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | veltro | noun “hound” | **psa** | dog (genitive) | OK | | verrà | future verb “will come” | **przyjdzie** | will come | OK | | che | conjunction “that” (introducing result clause) | **który** | which (relative) | OK | | la | pronoun “her” (direct object) | **ona** | she | OK | | farà | causative verb “will make” | **sprawi** | will cause/make | OK | | morir | infinitive “die” | **umrze** | will die | OK | | con | preposition “with / of” (in “die of grief”) | **z** | with / of | OK | | doglia | noun “grief” | **żalu** | grief (genitive) | OK |

### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *li*, *’l* – Italian articles have no direct equivalent in Polish and are correctly omitted. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected; all Polish forms agree in gender, number, and case with the intended meaning.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Polish script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Polish text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 100** - Original: Wiele jest zwierząt, z którymi ona się żeni, - Issue: GRAMMAR – “żenić się” is used for men; for a female subject the idiomatic form is “wychodzi za mąż”. - Corrected: Wiele jest zwierząt, z którymi ona **wychodzi za mąż**,
- **Line 101** - Original: i będzie ich jeszcze więcej aż do przyjścia psa - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- **Line 102** - Original: przyjdzie, który sprawi, że ona umrze z żalu. - Issue: GRAMMAR – the relative pronoun “który” cannot refer to the verb “przyjdzie”; use “co” (or a similar neutral pronoun). - Corrected: **przyjdzie, co** sprawi, że ona umrze z żalu.
``` Wiele jest zwierząt, z którymi ona wychodzi za mąż, i będzie ich jeszcze więcej aż do przyjścia psa przyjdzie, co sprawi, że ona umrze z żalu. ```
